Social Life
It is important for us that you have a great time as a student here at Østfold University of Applied Sciences. Find an association or organization that suits you, or you can start up your own.

Activity and Sports
As a student with us, you can join several different teams and associations. Here you can cultivate your interests and get to know new people.
Here you can read more about student activity and sports
Associations and Organizations
Join an association, organization, newspaper or other associations driven by students. You become part of a social community and maybe you learn some new skills.
Here you can read more about student associations and organizations
Halden Student Society (HSS)
Halden Student Society (HSS) is the welfare organization for students in Halden. All students at the Halden campus are members of HSS. The Student Society must contribute to our students having an active and social life during their studies. This is done through, among other things:
Quiz
Parties
Events
Teams and organisations
Here you can read more about Halden Student Society
